description: Send a Microsoft XPS (.xps) or OpenXPS (.oxps) file as base64 and get a PDF back with real, searchable text (vector output, not a screenshot), all documents of the file in one PDF, or every page as a JPG / PNG picture (ZIP). Damaged or non-XPS files get a clear error. Open-source libgxps on our server, 0 AI, nothing stored. For document pipelines, print-to-file archives, helpdesks and no-code flows. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.002/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/xps-to-pdf.

fileContent.description: The .xps or .oxps file as base64, max 50 MB (empty = built-in example)

format.description: pdf (default), or jpg / png pictures of every page (one file or a ZIP)

name: xps_to_pdf
title: XPS to PDF API - convert Windows XPS and OXPS documents to PDF (or JPG/PNG pages)
